units: <cite ref="Gittin 56a:16">Gitt. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>אייתי מידי ס׳ וכ׳</he> get some putrid substance and have it placed by thy side (in the coffin).
B. Bath. 19ᵇ בס׳ if the straw is decaying.—Trnsf. (of persons) ill-reputed, rogue.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 93b:21">B. Mets. 93ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>גנבא ס׳</he> contemptible thief that thou art.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 7:13:5">Y. Snh. VII, end, 25ᵈ</cite> <he>לסַרְיָה קרא וכ׳</he> (ed. Krot. <he>לסריח</he>) he called some rogue, and he stole &c., v. <cite ref="B01145"><he>בַּקְרוּתָא</he> I</cite>.
